records.name: Madras Veterinary College
records.statutory_basis: Tamil Nadu government veterinary college constituent of TANUVAS
records.evidence: The official TANUVAS site identifies Madras Veterinary College as its constituent veterinary college offering B.V.Sc. and postgraduate admissions.

records.name: College of Veterinary Science Hyderabad
records.statutory_basis: Telangana government veterinary college constituent of PVNR Veterinary University
records.evidence: The official college site identifies the College of Veterinary Science, Rajendranagar, as a Telangana public veterinary college with B.V.Sc. and postgraduate programmes.

records.name: KGMU Lucknow (Physiotherapy)
records.statutory_basis: programme of King George's Medical University, a Uttar Pradesh state university
records.evidence: The official KGMU site publishes physiotherapy degree programmes under King George's Medical University, a Uttar Pradesh public medical university.
notes: Department/programme row; parent KGMU linking should be handled by the department cleanup pass.

records.name: CMC Vellore (Physiotherapy)
records.evidence: The official CMC Vellore site publishes BPT and MPT physiotherapy admissions under its Christian charitable trust medical institution.
notes: Department/programme row; parent CMC Vellore linking should be handled by the department cleanup pass.

records.name: National Institute of Biologicals
records.statutory_basis: autonomous body under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
records.evidence: The official NIB site identifies the institute as a Ministry of Health and Family Welfare biologicals quality-assurance body providing professional training and internships, not a degree-admitting college.
notes: Non-degree training/research body; keep outside the college ladder.

records.name: Wildlife Institute of India
records.statutory_basis: autonomous institution under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
records.evidence: The official WII site identifies it as a national autonomous wildlife research and training institute offering postgraduate and doctoral programmes.

records.name: Forest Research Institute (FRI)
records.statutory_basis: autonomous institute under the Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education
records.evidence: The official ICFRE page identifies FRI as an autonomous central forestry research institute offering postgraduate and doctoral programmes.

records.name: CFSL (Central Forensic Science Laboratory)
records.statutory_basis: central forensic laboratory under the Directorate of Forensic Science Services, Ministry of Home Affairs
records.evidence: The official CFSL site identifies the laboratory as a central government forensic analysis and training body, not a degree-admitting college.
notes: Non-degree forensic laboratory; keep outside the college ladder.

records.name: Central Food Technological Research Institute (CFTRI)
records.evidence: The official CFTRI site identifies it as a CSIR food-science research institute with postgraduate and doctoral research programmes through AcSIR.

records.name: Lady Hardinge Medical College
records.statutory_basis: central government medical college affiliated with the University of Delhi
records.evidence: The official LHMC site identifies Lady Hardinge Medical College as a central government medical college in New Delhi offering MBBS and postgraduate admissions.
